title: Entrance Fee Agreement Amortization Percentage by Months Already Amortized
content:
Under the **Entrance Fee Agreement**, every month of occupancy is amortized at the plan's monthly amortization percentage of the entrance fee rounded to the cent half up, except the final period of a terminated agreement, whose percentage is the plan's monthly amortization percentage scaled by the months already amortized: where 36 or more months already carry an amortization entry it is one half of the plan's percentage, where 18 to 35 months do it is three quarters of the plan's percentage, and where fewer than 18 do it is the plan's percentage itself.

The months already amortized are the amortization entries on the agreement's ledger, counted when the final period is figured.

## Scaling ladder

| Months already carrying an amortization entry | Percentage of the final period |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | The plan's percentage multiplied by 0.5 |
| 18 to 35 | The plan's percentage multiplied by 0.75 |
| Fewer than 18 | The plan's percentage |

## Boundaries

| Entries on the ledger | Multiplier on the plan's percentage |
|---|---|
| 36 | 0.5 |
| 35 | 0.75 |
| 18 | 0.75 |
| 17 | 1 |

## Final-period percentage by plan monthly rate

| Plan monthly percentage | 36 or more entries | 18 to 35 entries | Fewer than 18 entries |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2.0 (LifeChoice Declining Balance, LifeChoice 50% Refundable, LifeCare Declining Balance) | 1.0 | 1.5 | 2.0 |
| 1.5 (LifeChoice 75% Refundable) | 0.75 | 1.125 | 1.5 |
| 1.0 (LifeChoice 90% Refundable, LifeCare 90% Refundable) | 0.5 | 0.75 | 1.0 |
